spesialisasi_singkat: Actuary, Underwriting, and Data Analytics Enthusiast
deskripsi:
I am an Actuarial Science graduate with a strong interest in Actuarial, Underwriting, and Data Analytics. My experience in the insurance industry has given me practical exposure to insurance operations, document review, claims administration, and insurance data analysis across different business divisions.

With a strong quantitative background, I enjoy working with data, solving problems, and turning complex information into meaningful insights. I have worked on actuarial research, insurance data projects, statistical analysis, and machine learning, while continuously developing my skills in various data analysis tools, programming languages, and analytical technologies.

I am a detail-oriented and curious person who enjoys learning new things, adapting to different challenges, and collaborating with others. Through this website, I share my professional journey, experiences, projects, and work that reflect my interests and growth in the insurance and data analytics fields.
